en.headline: The Pizza Bar by Daniele Cason opens at Mandarin Oriental Hong Kong
en.dek: The counter-style pizza omakase from the Tokyo venue ranked No. 2 by 50 Top Pizza in 2025 begins service on Monday at the hotel’s mezzanine in Central.
body: Mandarin Oriental, Hong Kong said The Pizza Bar by Daniele Cason opened on Monday, bringing the chef-led pizza omakase concept from its Tokyo sister property to the mezzanine floor of the Central hotel.

Chef Daniele Cason, who joined Mandarin Oriental, Tokyo in 2013 and later became executive chef, created The Pizza Bar on 38th there. That venue was ranked No. 2 in the world by 50 Top Pizza in 2025 and had previously been named Asia’s top pizzeria for three consecutive years, according to the hotel.

Guests sit at a small counter and watch pizzas being prepared with a 72-hour fermented dough and seasonal toppings drawn from Italian and Japanese ingredients. The bar is open for lunch in two sittings from 11:30am and for dinner from 6pm, and is closed on Mondays. Counter seating is recommended for adults and children over 12; families with younger children are encouraged to use the private dining room. Smart casual dress is required.
Bookings can be made by telephone or through the hotel’s website. The opening follows earlier pop-up appearances by the Tokyo team in Hong Kong in previous years.

zh.headline: 文華東方酒店The Pizza Bar by Daniele Cason周一開業
zh.dek: 來自東京、2025年獲50 Top Pizza評為全球第二的廚師發辦薄餅吧，周一於中環酒店夾層正式開業。
body: 文華東方酒店表示，The Pizza Bar by Daniele Cason周一開業，把東京姊妹酒店的廚師主理薄餅發辦體驗帶到中環酒店夾層。
主廚Daniele Cason於2013年加入東京文華東方酒店，其後擔任行政主廚，並創辦該店的The Pizza Bar on 38th。酒店指，該店於2025年獲50 Top Pizza評為全球第二，此前亦連續三年獲評亞洲第一薄餅店。
賓客坐在小型吧桌前，近距離觀看以72小時發酵麵粕及來自意大利與日本時令食材製成的薄餅。餐廳周一休息，午市設兩個時段由上午11時30分起，晚市由下午6時起。吧桌座位建議12歲或以上人士使用，攜同較年幼兒童的家庭可預訂包廂。衣着要求為智能休閒。
訂座可致電酒店或經官方網站。此正式開業前，東京團隊曾多次以快閃形式到香港文華東方酒店展示。
